create_deimv2_config: create a Deimv2Config instance with custom num_queries and decoder_layers for object detection
initialize_deimv2_config_from_pretrained: initialize a Deimv2Config from a pretrained checkpoint like Intellindust/DEIMv2_HGNetv2_N_COCO
validate_deimv2_architecture: validate the Deimv2Config architecture to ensure decoder_n_points matches num_feature_levels
customize_deimv2_encoder: customize the Deimv2Config encoder by setting encoder_type to lite and encoder_fuse_op to sum
configure_deimv2_loss_weights: configure the Deimv2Config loss weights for weight_loss_vfl, weight_loss_bbox, and weight_loss_giou
